title: Performance Whey Protein Blend (Vanilla)
body_html:
Whether you're staying active, working toward fitness goals, or simply prioritizing healthy aging, adequate protein intake is essential for maintaining muscle mass. Our Vanilla Whey Protein provides 22 grams of protein per serving from a carefully selected blend of whey protein isolate and whey protein concentrate. The smooth vanilla flavor makes it easy to enjoy any time of day.

Protein is a key nutrient for supporting muscle health and normal post-exercise recovery. This formula supplies all essential amino acids naturally present in whey protein, helping you meet your daily protein needs while supporting an active lifestyle. It's an excellent choice after workouts, as a nutritious snack, or as part of your daily wellness routine.

To complement its protein content, this formula also includes resistant potato starch, a source of dietary fiber. Naturally flavored and sweetened with stevia leaf extract, it delivers a clean, satisfying taste without artificial sweeteners. Simply mix with water for a convenient protein shake that fits seamlessly into your day.*


Ingredients: Whey Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate) (22g), Solnul® (Resistant Potato Starch), Natural Flavors, Pink Himalayan Crystal Salt, Guar Gum, Xanthan Gum, and Stevia Leaf Extract.
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 16.9oz / 1.06 lb / 480g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 20.64 oz / 1.29 lb / 585 g
Suggested use: Add one serving (2 scoops) to 8–12 oz (240–355 ml) of cold water and blend or shake thoroughly.
Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consult a physician if pregnant, nursing, under 18, or have a medical condition.
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
